about: Watchtower (maintained fork nicholas-fedor/watchtower; containrrr/watchtower was archived 2025-12-17) through shoutrrr ntfy (nicholas-fedor/shoutrrr pkg/services/push/ntfy): POST https://host/<topic-path> where the shoutrrr URL path is the topic, so a path prefix works. Body is the raw message, Content-Type text/plain; charset=utf-8, headers Title/Priority (enum NAME, e.g. high)/Tags. Auth: Bearer from ?token= in the shoutrrr URL, else Basic from user:pass in it (ntfy://:KEY@host/... gives an empty username). Parses the response as JSON; a non-JSON 200 is an error.
provenance: Rebuilt from the sender's source code and docs on 2026-11-04, not captured from a live sender. Replace with a capture when one exists (integrations/alert-intake/README.md, Capturing fixtures).
